references.role: approved Covenant creature anatomy, palette and style

input.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Original painted game character ANIMATION SHEET on uniform vivid MAGENTA #FF00FF. Reference-1.png is the exact character identity and equipment reference. Reference-2.png is the APPROVED COVENANT CREATURE SOURCE, the authority for anatomy, palette and painting style. Use BOTH references visually. Match its lighter stylized painted values and simple sculpted shapes exactly; do not darken into realistic horror, add photoreal skin or fur, or add black shadows. Reference-1 is an A10 master or a crop of that approved source. Generate the requested anatomical view even if the reference is a rear view. This is an ANIMAL ONLY. No human body, no clothes, no weapon or staff, no hands. Keep its exact creature anatomy. For ALL poses the camera sees BACK surfaces. During collapse fall FORWARD AWAY from the camera, finally FACE-DOWN with the back uppermost and the face HIDDEN. Never turn to face the viewer, never roll onto the back. Raw magical broad squat amphibian-like bog creature, four short splayed legs, heavy moss-green stone hide, broad round mouth, luminous turquoise throat sac, root tendrils and wet mist. Chunky artillery silhouette; intact non-gory creature. REAR-RIGHT three-quarter view, head and torso facing diagonally AWAY from viewer and toward image RIGHT, back surfaces visible. Maintain this anatomical view for every pose, including resting body; do not rotate a flat upright sprite. Camera elevated 55-degree orthographic, not eye-level. Exactly THREE columns by TWO rows, SIX complete sequential poses of the same creature. Row 1: 1 ready animal stance; 2 legs fold and chest lowers; 3 belly and chest very low. Row 2: 4 creature tips gently onto its side; 5 head, chest and belly touch the ground; 6 fully still LYING FLAT ON ITS SIDE, head resting on ground, legs relaxed. Keep its intact animal anatomy, no human posture or equipment. The final body lies on the ground, never standing, crouching or sitting. Non-graphic creature collapsing and lying on the ground, no gore, no blood, no injury detail. Each complete creature occupies only HALF its spacious cell, with all tail, horns, antennae and wings inside wide empty gutters. Each equal cell contains ONE entire body at IDENTICAL anatomical scale. Each body and all equipment fit within middle 60% of the cell, including lying poses. Wide completely empty magenta gutters. No text, numbers, labels, panel borders, shadows, floor, scene, magic aura, extra figures or chopped anatomy. Do not let staff, tail, wing or foot cross a cell boundary. Original hand-painted digital dark fantasy. Sculpted painterly volume, broken confident contours, sharply selected silver highlights, worn dark metal and pale layered cloth. Material wear only at physical edges, broad quiet ground planes and smooth opaque paint. No grain, paper, canvas texture, noise overlay, stippling, photorealism or 3D render. Roman culture supplies arena masonry and ordinary legion equipment; magical figures and creatures are raw original fantastical designs. Shared cool upper-left light and small contact shadows. Smooth opaque painted cloth and metal, rich physical volume, no heavy cartoon outline. Sheet aspect 1:1. Original designs only. CORRECTION: REAR view throughout. Final resting animal points its head to the UPPER RIGHT and hind legs to LOWER LEFT. Camera sees the mossy BACK and BACK OF HEAD; mouth hidden on far side. The turquoise throat sac is hidden behind the head and torso from this rear camera. Never turn the head toward the viewer. Final belly and chin lie against ground with four splayed relaxed limbs. Exactly six poses in 3 columns 2 rows; whole body fits in each cell.

arguments.Prompt: Original hand-painted digital dark fantasy game animation sheet on a solid uniform vivid MAGENTA #FF00FF background. Exactly 6 sequential collapse death animation poses arranged in a clean 3 columns by 2 rows grid (3x2). Character: mire maw creature matching reference-1.png and reference-2.png. Raw magical squat broad amphibian bog beast, bulky chunky artillery silhouette, four short splayed toad-like legs, textured moss-green stone hide, dorsal ridges and rocky back plate, vine and root tendrils. Animal only, non-humanoid, no clothes, no weapons, intact non-gory creature. Camera & Perspective: 55-degree elevated orthographic rear-right three-quarter perspective (rear view). For all 6 poses, the camera views the creature from behind / REAR-RIGHT: the mossy back, dorsal stone carapace, and back of the head are facing the viewer. The creature's head is pointed diagonally away towards the upper-right, and rear legs are toward lower-left. The front face, mouth, and turquoise throat sac are turned away and concealed from this rear camera view. Never turn to face the viewer. Poses (3 columns x 2 rows, sequential collapse animation): Row 1: Cell 1 (top-left): Ready animal stance, elevated rear 3/4 view, heavy mossy back visible, body alert. Cell 2 (top-center): Legs begin to fold, body sinking and chest lowering towards the ground. Cell 3 (top-right): Belly and chest low to the ground, legs buckling outwards, body collapsing forward. Row 2: Cell 4 (bottom-left): Creature collapsing flat onto its belly/ground, limbs spreading out, head dipping down. Cell 5 (bottom-center): Head, chest, and belly touching the ground, slipping into stillness, body flattened forward. Cell 6 (bottom-right): Final motionless collapse resting pose: lying completely flat and still on the ground, prone with chin and belly pressed to the ground, head pointed toward upper-right, four short splayed relaxed legs, mossy back and dorsal stone shell facing the camera. Composition & Style: Solid pure vivid MAGENTA #FF00FF background throughout, with wide empty magenta margins and gutters separating each cell. Each creature occupies only 50-60% of its spacious cell, centered with generous padding. No parts touching or crossing cell boundaries. No panel borders, no grid lines, no text, no numbers, no labels, no floor, no shadows on floor, no UI. Stylized hand-painted dark fantasy digital art style matching Reference-2.png: sculpted painterly volumes, cool directional lighting from upper-left, moss-green tones, stone textures, smooth opaque paint, no photorealism, no 3D render, no heavy cartoon outlines.
